description:
Adam and Jamie put fire and explosion myths to the test, pushing everyday objects to their breaking point. From exploding lighters to a massive underwater detonation, these experiments show just how wild things get when myths go boom.

About MythBusters:
Two special effects experts with over 30 years of experience set out to methodically bust three urban legends in each episode. They test theories to prove or disprove what is real and what is truly urban myth.
